skill.name: xhs-competitor-research-v2
skill.description: Search Xiaohongshu posts through SocialDataX and compare competitor topics, audience feedback, and creator positioning using a defined sample.
skill.summary: Compare Xiaohongshu competitor content and separate observed patterns from strategic conclusions.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick alerts are Markdown, but the workflow directs users and agents to run an unpinned package that handles credentials. Search inputs cross a shell and service boundary, and the output instructions require sharing full token-bearing URLs. No embedded API key, obfuscated payload, or attempt to override the audit was found in the supplied files.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution with credential access
remediation.suggestion: Use an exact, reviewed package release with verified integrity. Require explicit approval before installation or first execution, and prefer an approved read-only connector.

remediation.issue: Persistent credentials and inherited environment access
remediation.suggestion: Use an approved secret store and pass only the scoped credential the CLI needs. Document credential precedence, deletion, and rotation. Verify that status checks never disclose credentials.
Use a structured connector or a subprocess argument array without a shell. Keep keywords and cursor values out of command text and redact cursors from logs.
Use note IDs or verified share-safe links in reports. Keep full token-bearing URLs private unless sharing is necessary and explicitly authorized.
Disclose that SocialDataX receives search terms and that requests may include attribution fields. Confirm that confidential terms are approved for external use and set a request limit.

content.value_statement: Xiaohongshu search results can be difficult to compare consistently. This skill organizes a defined sample by topic, content angle, creator positioning, and visible audience feedback.
actual_capabilities: Search Xiaohongshu notes by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Filter searches by post type and publication period, and sort by recency, likes, comments, or saves.
Limit CLI collection by pages or item count, and continue a search using its returned pagination cursor.
Summarize note titles, creators, reference IDs, and visible audience signals from returned results.
Compare topics and content angles while separating observed evidence from interpretation.
limitations: Live searches require an authenticated SocialDataX connection or local CLI credentials. Search requests may consume account credits.
Ranked results and page limits do not provide complete Xiaohongshu coverage or representative market estimates.
The advertised CLI uses an unpinned package release. Review and approve it before giving it access to credentials.
Returned URLs can contain access tokens. Use note IDs in shared reports unless the links are verified as appropriate to share.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Messaging
use_cases.description: Review a limited sample for competing brands and identify repeated product claims, post formats, and audience questions.

use_cases.title: Review Creator Positioning
use_cases.description: Compare how creators present the same topic and note which audience signals appear in each sample.

use_cases.title: Plan a Content Test
use_cases.description: Find relevant recent posts, group their content angles, and choose one idea to test with your audience.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Search Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use an approved SocialDataX connection to search Xiaohongshu for [topic]. Review only the first page. List up to five relevant posts with titles and note IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] on Xiaohongshu for [topic]. Use one page per brand and the same filters. Separate content observations from your interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Recent Content Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [topic] on Xiaohongshu for the past seven days using public posting dates. Cap each search at two pages. Group posts by angle and cite note IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Linked Research Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Evaluate content across matched samples.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [three public terms] using the same date window, post type, sort order, and two-page limit per term. Record sample sizes and gaps. Cite note IDs, compare creator positioning, and propose two testable hypotheses.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review one page of posts about travel-size skincare.
output: Sample: Five relevant posts from the first search page.
Observation: Three posts show packing lists. Two explain how to select product sizes.
Next question: Do checklist posts receive more visible saves than product comparisons in a larger sample?

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare two fictional commuter backpack brands over the past week.
output: Sample: Four relevant Brand A posts and three Brand B posts under the same filters.
Observation: Brand A posts emphasize organization. Brand B posts emphasize weather protection.
Interpretation: These angles differ in this sample. The results do not show which message performs better overall.

best_practices: Start with one page and set a clear item or page limit before expanding the search.
Use the same filters for comparison groups and label observations separately from hypotheses.
Use an approved connection, search with nonconfidential terms, and use note IDs for shared references.
anti_patterns: Treating results from a few ranked pages as a complete view of the market.
Pasting API keys, pagination cursors, or token-bearing links into shared prompts or reports.
Running an unreviewed package with access to a credential store.

faq.question: What do I need for live searches?
faq.answer: Use an approved authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection or a reviewed CLI with a configured credential. Never paste the API key into chat.

faq.question: Does the research workflow change my Xiaohongshu account?
faq.answer: The documented search workflow is read-only. It does not publish posts, like content, leave comments, or modify your Xiaohongshu account.

faq.question: Can I focus on recent video posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Select video as the post type and a supported publication window. The CLI also supports filtering by a specified number of recent days.

faq.question: What if a search runs out of credits?
faq.answer: Stop repeated requests and check the balance on the provider account. Keep any partial sample labeled as incomplete.

faq.question: Do I get every post for a keyword?
faq.answer: No. Sort order, filters, and page limits determine which posts appear in the sample.

faq.question: How should I cite a post in a shared report?
faq.answer: Use the note title, creator, and note ID. Include a direct link only after confirming it is appropriate for the intended audience.
